name: little-alchemy-coop
description: Unofficial peer-to-peer co-op for Little Alchemy (classic) as a Chrome/Firefox extension.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test
scripts.test:integration: npm run build && playwright test test/integration
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && playwright test test/e2e
scripts.lint:ext: npm run build && web-ext lint --source-dir extension
scripts.run:firefox: npm run build && web-ext run --source-dir extension --url https://littlealchemy.com/
scripts.package: npm run build && web-ext build --source-dir extension --artifacts-dir dist-packages --filename little-alchemy-coop-{version}.zip --overwrite-dest
scripts.sign:firefox: npm run build && web-ext sign --source-dir extension --artifacts-dir dist-packages --channel unlisted
